description: Extrapolate OpenBookQA accuracy with tokens seen across IBM's released dense and mixture-of-experts training trajectories.

contract.law_signature: law(input_data: list[dict[str, float]], group: str) -> list[dict[str, float]]

target_description: Source-reported openbookqa accuracy; larger values represent better performance.

measurement_provenance.method: direct official CSV rows; B/M suffixes converted to numeric token and parameter counts; blank separators and nonnumeric corpus-end labels excluded; trajectories with fewer than four nonmissing metric values excluded
